name: eDesk
task: A help desk, tickets or a shared inbox
summary: E-commerce helpdesk: one unified inbox for Amazon, eBay, Shopify and email, with order data and an AI Agent that bills per resolved outcome.
best_for: e-commerce and marketplace sellers who want one unified inbox across Amazon, eBay, Shopify and email: with order data and AI-assisted replies where support and revenue overlap
skip_if: you run a non-commerce SaaS or service business (general helpdesks fit better and cheaper), or your ticket volume is low enough that a shared inbox already copes
honest_knock: There are two meters, and the second one is easy to miss. The per-agent price is the entry ticket, but the AI Agent charges $0.99 for every automated resolution on top. That is great when it deflects real tickets, but it is a variable line item that scales with your support volume: model it against your ticket count before assuming a flat bill. And the honest fundamental for any e-commerce helpdesk: the value is only as good as your marketplace integrations actually syncing: test Amazon/eBay/Shopify connections with your real accounts during the free trial.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Essential, per agent · per agent per month billed annually ($55 billed monthly)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-10) No free plan: 'Start for free' opens a 14-day full-feature trial with no credit card. Essential $45 per agent/mo, Growth $99, Professional $129 (the plan eDesk marks Most Popular), Enterprise custom — all billed annually. Billed monthly the same plans cost $55, $125 and $159; the annual rate is the '20% off' eDesk advertises. The AI Agent is included on every plan, but its automated resolutions bill separately at $0.99 per outcome: you pay when it actually resolves a query, not per attempt. eDesk claims the agent can automate up to 65% of support across channels, so model the outcome fee against your ticket volume — at 1,000 resolved tickets a month that is $990 on top of the seats.
